Someone died in the Thais sewers while carrying an axe. Go down into the sewers near the depot, open a hidden hole with a {item:Pick}, kill 4 {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} and take a {item:Battle Axe} from a pile of bones.
Someone died in the sewers while carrying an axe.

or equivalent, to get out of the hole
or equivalent, to open the hole
It's a very quick quest (1–5 minutes), ideal for low levels.

In {wiki:Thais}, go to the depot and enter the {wiki:Thais Sewers|Thais sewers} through one of the {item:Sewer Grate|sewer grates} near it (see the image): just step on the grate to fall to the floor below. Down there you'll find {creature:Rat|Rats}.
Enter through one of these sewer grates
Cross the sewers to the **southwest** end of the cave.
Follow the green line to the southwest end of the sewers
Open the hole with the pick
At the dead end on the **east** side, use the {item:Pick} on the ground **2 squares north** of where the dead end finishes. A hole opens: go down.
Use the Pick on this square
Kill the 4 {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} and use the {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|pile of bones} to get the {item:Battle Axe}.
Use the pile of bones to get the Battle Axe

Use the {item:Rope} on the hole you came down through to get back to the sewers. Then follow the green line in reverse, back to the depot area, and go up the stairs under the grate you came in by: you come out onto the streets of {wiki:Thais} again, next to the depot.
Southwest tip of the sewers (near the hole)
Without a {item:Rope} (or equivalent) you can't climb out of the {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}' hole.
